convention_block.reference_area_convention: propeller disk conventions below; blade station chords in metres
convention_block.wind_reference: not-applicable (tunnel/bench data carry their own q)

identity_note: This artifact's content identity is its fs-blake3 hash at commit (tracked via the source manifest); consumers pin the hash, not the path.

coefficient_conventions.CT: T / (rho * n^2 * D^4), n in rev/s
coefficient_conventions.phi_station: chord inclination from the ROTATION PLANE, atan((z_le-z_te)/(x_le-x_te)) per NTRS 20020080869

overall_geometry.material_1903: THREE spruce boards glued face-to-face (wright-brothers.org); 1911 bent-end adds muslin tip sheaths
overall_geometry.tip_shape_1903: STRAIGHT wide-tip paddle — the 'bent end' (rearward-swept tip) design emerged from 1905 testing and is standard only ~1912+; the tested LFST reproductions with published curves are circa-1911 BENT-END props, NOT the 1903 geometry

radial_geometry_1903.finding: NO station-by-station c(r)/beta(r) table for the 1903 propeller exists in the open literature (verified 2026-08-18 across NTRS, CiteSeerX, DTIC, AIAA listings). AIAA 2001-0309 describes the laser scan of the broken originals and promises the data 'in a subsequent publication' that never openly appeared. The Wright Experience holds the complete private digital reconstruction.

reconstruction_paths.path: digitize sections from the Smithsonian CC0 3-D scan of the whole Flyer (3d.si.edu, OBJ/GLB, exhibit-scale — envelope/twist sanity, NOT airfoil-section fidelity)
scale the 1911 NTRS planform trend to the sparse 1903 numbers (tip width 8 in, straight tip, pitch lineage)
reconstruct via the Wrights' own design method (constant-alpha blade element, McFarland design pitch) as Carroll & Carroll 2005 did
contact The Wright Experience for the private scan (data-rights negotiation, E1.10 adjacent)

radial_geometry_1903.sim_rule: any 1903 radial table the simulation uses is a RECONSTRUCTION artifact carrying its path + Estimated ceiling; it can never be promoted by agreement with the 1911 table (different geometry)

radial_geometry_1911_bentend.warning: 1911 BENT-END geometry — NOT the 1903 flight propeller. Published use: BEMT method-validation fixture (V-03 calibration), planform-trend prior.
radial_geometry_1911_bentend.source: NASA NTRS 20020080869 (Wang/Ash/Bobbitt), measured at NASA Langley; R = 51 in, D = 8.5 ft; sections at r/R 0.96 and 1.0 reuse the 0.9 airfoil; cambered concave-lower sections with blunt TE
radial_geometry_1911_bentend.section_coordinates: published as report FIGURES only (Figs 1.01-2.08); the (x,z) files are NOT open — mean thickness estimable from area/chord

static_1903.wrights_bench: 132-136 lb PAIR at 350 rpm (Dayton outdoor, 1903-11-21) => 67 +/- 1 lb per prop
static_1903.lfst_reproduction: 64.2 +/- 1.1 lb at 350.1 +/- 0.6 rpm (46 F, 29.97 inHg) — 'very good to excellent' CT agreement with the Wrights' reduction

eta_band_1903.lineage: SECONDARY (Ash/Britcher/Hyde centennial article via cites; wright-brothers.org says ~0.70; Wilbur's own 66% is a CALCULATION) — a band, never a datum; no open 1903 CT(J)/CP(J) curve exists
eta_band_1903.sim_rule: 1903 forward-flight validation anchors are the static point + this band; fitting to the band is forbidden (holdout)

curves_1911_bentend.warning: 1911 geometry — validates the BEMT METHOD, never 1903 values
curves_1911_bentend.notes: experimental stall at J ~ 1.29; CT column partially OCR-garbled in the open scan (individual CT points +/- 0.02); CFD (FLO_MG + Adkins-Liebeck) within a few percent over J 0.6-1.15

operating_points.note: arithmetic re-derived and battery-checked against flyer-reference values

J_rail_dec17.plan_check: the plan's held-on-rail J ~ 0.7-0.8 CONFIRMED (0.80 at 27 mph gusts)

J_liftoff_dec17.derivation: V_air ~ 13.86 m/s at 350 rpm => J = 13.86/15.11; J sweeps 0.71 -> 0.92 during the run

J_design_wilbur.derivation: design point 90 lb total at 24 mph and 330 rpm: 10.73/(5.5*2.5908)

blade_solid_for_collision_proxy.open_source_geometry: Smithsonian CC0 3-D scan of NASM A19610048000 (props installed), 3d.si.edu OBJ/GLB/GLTF/USDZ — the ONLY open 3-D source; exhibit-scale
blade_solid_for_collision_proxy.private_geometry: Wright Experience complete digital 1903 reconstruction (rapid-prototyping grade) — exists, never released
blade_solid_for_collision_proxy.rule: the proxy's cover-error certificate must be measured against whichever solid is actually used, and the artifact id binds that choice

no_claims: Registry of published propeller geometry/performance evidence and its boundaries. The 1911 table validates methods, not 1903 values; every 1903 radial table in the sim is a labeled reconstruction; the eta band is secondary lineage and holdout-only.
